forum.title: STM32H7 SDMMC2 Init Fails -- Get Status Data Reads fail to populate FIFO
forum.best_answer_content: I found that my ESD protection IC (EMIF04-1005M8) blocks the data line signals from getting from the MCU to the SD card.  I put a jumper from the D0 pin of the MCU to the D0 pin of the SD card and successful data reads and writes occured.  After some troubleshooting, I discovered that the ground pad of the UDFN-8 package of the ESD protection IC had too much solder on it, so it blobbed over and shorted my data line to ground.  I wicked the solder off, resoldered the IC, and now it works great.  Problem solved.
forum.author: ReaganHammond
